style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: he crosses the frame every beat; camera arcs round him, new shot size each beat; he fills half the frame
character: palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, long thin fingers, huge scared amber eyes, loose tie, utterly serious; ONE fat toad banker, throat ballooning
props: ONE oak desk; ONE blank schedule roll; ONE red stamp; ONE tiny plain cloth pouch; ONE plain coin; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: stamp: toad's till 3.95, then desk; roll: toad's till 8.15, then out the pane; pouch his from 3.95; coin from 9.4
environment: sunlit bank office, oak panelling, tall open pane, sill flush with the desk end; the toad's leather chair

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, alarmed, even 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mo-EE gla-ZA, VEE-dyat, o-SO-ben-no, SRO-ki, ot-da-VAT stress last, KA-zhet-sya, u-ZHE, ZAV-tra
audio.pacing: 0.9-6.85 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.85 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: paper, stamp thump, stomps, croak, coin clink

timeline.a: he whirls round the stamp handle like a pole, legs flung out flat; the toad clutches the stamp, gaping
he lets go, somersaulting along the desk onto the unspooling roll; the toad thumps the stamp down behind him
he scuttles off along the desk, head snapping 180° back; the toad puffs, leaning after him
timeline.c: low, 90° arc; HE fills half the frame

timeline.a: he flinches and hops aside along the roll; the toad swats the desk beside him
he zigzags along the roll, clutching its edge; the toad hops alongside, waving the stamp
he struts forward, chest out, yanking the pouch from behind his tie; the toad rears back, dropping the stamp
timeline.c: orbit, he fills half the frame

timeline.a: he stomps at the toad in brisk short strides, elbows pumping, pouch fist out; the toad backs away along the desk
he marches on, head whipping 180° back mid-stride, eyes huge; the toad keeps backing, puffing
timeline.c: chest-up, half orbit to his face

timeline.a: he stomps on, pouch fist out, driving the toad onto the sill; it hugs the roll
timeline.c: arc ahead, he over half the frame

timeline.a: he springs onto the sill, jabbing the pouch into the toad's belly; it croaks, squeezing the roll
he lunges along the sill; the toad flips backward out through the tall open pane, the roll unspooling after it
he scampers along the sill after the paper tail; it whips from his fingers
he skids to the sill's edge, windmilling, pouch flailing over the drop
he hops off the sill onto the desk, head swinging 180° back to the empty chair; a coin drops from the pouch, clinking

must_appear: stamp-handle whirl 0.0, pouch from his tie 3.95, head 180° mid-march 5.25, toad flipping out the open pane 7.5, roll after it, coin clink 9.4
negative_prompt: night, low key, held mic, him still, second tarsier, more toads, people, slow motion, any word after 6.85, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, eye macro, pause inside a line, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, him hanging on the frame, him running at the camera, far shot, still camera, still last second
